title: Web Application Security Final Assessment Blueprint

recommended_settings.attempts: Follow CodeLeaf platform exam policy; this blueprint does not change live attempt limits.

assessment_type: 40 single-choice risk/control questions plus human-reviewed project evidence; repository answer keys remain protected.
outcomes: Explain browser, HTTP, architecture, and security principles.
Select defensive controls for identity, authorization, input handling, API, file, and workflow risks.
Plan and document an authorized security assessment with sanitized evidence.
Map applicable controls to OWASP ASVS and WSTG verification approaches.
Apply secure-development, production, privacy, and incident-response practices.

topic_distribution.topic: Input handling, client-side, CSRF and server injection
SSRF, files, APIs, cryptography and business workflows
Configuration, supply chain, testing, operations, privacy and specializations

lesson_knowledge_checks: Every lesson has a separate three-question file. Answer keys and explanations stay in repository-side question data; the existing CodeLeaf knowledge-check endpoint strips them from learner-facing responses.
project_submission: Project coding and security tests require local/isolated execution and human review. Do not execute learner-supplied code inside the FastAPI process or production web container.
remediation_policy: Map missed outcomes to the relevant lesson and focused exercise; verify corrections through practice and the final review. Platform attempt limits remain authoritative.
